_comment: A2 level exam. Format: app/content/exams/README.md. Question ids are stable.

grammar.q: We ___ a great time in Bodrum last summer.
The flight ___ two hours late. (be)
answer: was

grammar.q: Last year I start a new job.
answer: Last year I started a new job.

grammar.q: The client is happy with our offer.
answer: The client was happy with our offer.

grammar.instruction_tr: [en:every Friday] yerine [en:last Friday] kullanarak geçmiş zamana çevir.
grammar.q: I write a report every Friday.
answer: I wrote a report last Friday.
Last Friday I wrote a report.

grammar.q: Kelimeleri sırala: [tr:Tren bu sabah çok gecikti.]
answer: The train was very late this morning.
This morning the train was very late.
The train this morning was very late.
grammar.explain_tr: [en:the train] = [en:it] → [en:was]; zaman ifadesi başa ya da sona gelebilir.

grammar.q: Kelimeleri sırala: [tr:Müdürüm geçen hafta bana yeni bir görev verdi.]
answer: My manager gave me a new task last week.
Last week my manager gave me a new task.

grammar.q: She ___ the email to the wrong person yesterday. (send)
answer: sent

grammar.q: What ___ you do after the meeting yesterday?
I ___ understand the question, so I asked again. (olumsuz)
answer: didn't
did not

grammar.q: Did you sent the invoice?
answer: Did you send the invoice?

grammar.q: We met the new manager.
answer: We didn't meet the new manager.
We did not meet the new manager.

grammar.q: She called the supplier.
answer: Did she call the supplier?

grammar.q: Kelimeleri sırala: [tr:Bana neden sorundan bahsetmedin?]
answer: Why didn't you tell me about the problem?

grammar.q: Kelimeleri sırala: [tr:Müşteri fiyat hakkında ne dedi?]
answer: What did the client say about the price?

grammar.q: ___ you at the office on Monday?
Can you call back later? I ___ dinner now.
She ___ three languages.
I am needing your help.
answer: I need your help.

grammar.q: He is talking to a customer.
answer: Is he talking to a customer?
grammar.explain_tr: Soruda [en:is] öznenin önüne geçer: [en:Is he talking …?]

grammar.instruction_tr: [en:now] yerine [en:every morning] kullanarak geniş zamana (present simple) çevir.
grammar.q: She is reading the news now.
answer: She reads the news every morning.
Every morning she reads the news.

grammar.q: Kelimeleri sırala: [tr:Bugün neden takım elbise giyiyorsun?]
answer: Why are you wearing a suit today?

grammar.q: Kelimeleri sırala: [tr:İş arkadaşım şu anda öğle yemeği yiyor.]
answer: My colleague is having lunch at the moment.
At the moment my colleague is having lunch.
grammar.explain_tr: Şu an olan iş → [en:is having] ([en:have lunch] = öğle yemeği yemek).

grammar.q: I can't talk now. I ___ a report. (write)
answer: am writing
'm writing
grammar.explain_tr: Şu an süren iş → [en:am writing] ([en:write] → [en:writing], [key:e] düşer).

grammar.q: I'm thirsty. — I ___ get you some water.
We ___ going to open a new office in Izmir next year. (be)
answer: are
're

grammar.q: I will to send it tomorrow.
answer: I will send it tomorrow.
I'll send it tomorrow.

grammar.q: We are going to hire a new designer.
answer: We aren't going to hire a new designer.
We are not going to hire a new designer.

grammar.q: The new system will be ready by Friday.
answer: Will the new system be ready by Friday?

grammar.q: Kelimeleri sırala: [tr:Gelecek hafta fabrikayı ziyaret edeceğim.]
answer: I'm going to visit the factory next week.
Next week I'm going to visit the factory.
grammar.explain_tr: Önceden verilmiş plan → [en:be going to] + yalın fiil.

grammar.q: Kelimeleri sırala: [tr:Cuma günü müşteriyle akşam yemeği yiyoruz.]
answer: We're having dinner with the client on Friday.
On Friday we're having dinner with the client.

grammar.q: Look at the traffic! We ___ be late for the meeting.
grammar.explain_tr: Kanıta dayalı tahmin → [en:are going to] + yalın fiil.

grammar.q: This laptop is ___ than the old one.
It was the ___ day of the year. (bad, en)
answer: worst

grammar.q: My new job is more better than the old one.
answer: My new job is better than the old one.

grammar.instruction_tr: İki cümleyi [en:than] ile tek cümlede karşılaştır ([en:The train …] ile başla).
grammar.q: The train is fast. The bus is slow.
answer: The train is faster than the bus.
The train is faster than the bus is.

grammar.instruction_tr: Aynı anlamda [en:not as … as] ile yeniden yaz ([en:light] kullan).
grammar.q: My new laptop is heavier than my old one.
answer: My new laptop isn't as light as my old one.
My new laptop is not as light as my old one.
My new laptop isn't as light as my old laptop.
My new laptop is not as light as my old laptop.
My new laptop isn't as light as my old one is.
My new laptop isn't as light as my old laptop is.
grammar.explain_tr: Daha ağır = o kadar hafif değil: [en:not as light as].

grammar.q: Kelimeleri sırala: [tr:Yeni yazıcı eskisinden çok daha hızlı.]
answer: The new printer is much faster than the old one.

grammar.q: Kelimeleri sırala: [tr:Yılın en zor toplantısıydı.]
answer: It was the most difficult meeting of the year.
grammar.explain_tr: Uzun sıfat → [en:the most difficult]; [tr:yılın] → [en:of the year].

grammar.q: This is the most cheap hotel in the area.
answer: This is the cheapest hotel in the area.

grammar.q: How ___ meetings do you have today?
Thanks for the useful ___. (bilgi)
answer: information

grammar.q: He gave me a lot of advices.
answer: He gave me a lot of advice.

grammar.q: We have some time before the meeting.
answer: We don't have any time before the meeting.
We do not have any time before the meeting.
We haven't got any time before the meeting.

grammar.instruction_tr: [en:How much] ile başlayan bir soru yap.
grammar.q: The project needs a lot of money.
answer: How much money does the project need?
How much does the project need?

grammar.q: Kelimeleri sırala: [tr:Mutfakta hiç kahve var mı?]
answer: Is there any coffee in the kitchen?

grammar.q: Kelimeleri sırala: [tr:Yeni müşteri hakkında fazla bilgimiz yok.]
answer: We don't have much information about the new client.
About the new client, we don't have much information.

grammar.q: I need ___ advice about my CV.
I need ___ umbrella. It's raining.
Have you seen ___ keys? I put them on the table.
answer: the
my

grammar.q: I go to the bed at midnight.
answer: I go to bed at midnight.

grammar.q: We hired new engineers.
answer: We hired a new engineer.
grammar.explain_tr: Tekil sayılabilen isim → [en:a]; [en:new] ünsüzle başlar → [en:a new].

grammar.q: They are interesting ideas.
answer: It's an interesting idea.
It is an interesting idea.

grammar.q: Kelimeleri sırala: [tr:Bir üniversitede muhasebeci olarak çalışıyor.]
answer: She works as an accountant at a university.
She works at a university as an accountant.
As an accountant, she works at a university.

grammar.q: Kelimeleri sırala: [tr:Her gün kahvaltıyı evde yaparım.]
answer: I have breakfast at home every day.
Every day I have breakfast at home.
I have breakfast every day at home.
At home, I have breakfast every day.
grammar.explain_tr: Öğün adları ve [en:at home] tanımlıksız kullanılır.

grammar.q: It takes ___ hour to get to the airport.
Who ___ you about the new rule?
How often ___ you check your email?
answer: do

grammar.q: Where you are from?
answer: Where are you from?

grammar.q: Zeynep found the mistake.
answer: Who found the mistake?

grammar.q: Burak bought a new car.
answer: What did Burak buy?
What did he buy?

grammar.q: Kelimeleri sırala: [tr:Eğitim ne kadar sürüyor?]
answer: How long does the training take?
grammar.explain_tr: Süre sorusu: [en:How long] + [en:does] + özne + yalın fiil.

grammar.q: Kelimeleri sırala: [tr:Kız kardeşin hangi departmanda çalışıyor?]
answer: Which department does your sister work in?
In which department does your sister work?
grammar.explain_tr: [en:Which] + isim + [en:does] + özne + fiil; edat ([en:in]) genelde sona gider.

grammar.q: What time the bank closes?
answer: What time does the bank close?

grammar.q: I look forward to ___ you on Monday.
Please find ___ the contract. (ekte)
answer: attached

grammar.q: I am writing for to ask about the price.
answer: I am writing to ask about the price.
I'm writing to ask about the price.

grammar.instruction_tr: Kibar bir ricaya çevir ([en:Could you …] ile başla).
grammar.q: Check the price list.
answer: Could you check the price list, please?
Could you please check the price list?
Could you check the price list?

grammar.instruction_tr: E-postanın amacını [en:I'm writing to …] kalıbıyla yaz.
grammar.q: I want to confirm my order.
answer: I'm writing to confirm my order.
I am writing to confirm my order.

grammar.q: Kelimeleri sırala: [tr:Pazartesi günkü e-postamla ilgili kısa bir hatırlatma yapıyorum.]
answer: I'm just following up on my email from Monday.
grammar.explain_tr: [en:follow up on …] = bir konuyu hatırlatmak, takip etmek.

grammar.q: Kelimeleri sırala: [tr:Perşembeye kadar cevap verebilir misiniz, lütfen?]
answer: Could you reply by Thursday, please?
Could you please reply by Thursday?
Please could you reply by Thursday?

grammar.q: Dear ___, I'm writing about your order. (alıcı: Ayşe Kaya, resmî e-posta)
Mr Arslan is in a meeting. Can I ___ a message?
Could I speak ___ Ms Güneş, please?
answer: to
with

grammar.q: Hello, I am Kemal from Ford Otosan.
answer: Hello, this is Kemal from Ford Otosan.
Hello, it's Kemal from Ford Otosan.

grammar.instruction_tr: Kibar bir ricaya çevir ([en:Could you …] ile başla).
grammar.q: Spell your surname.
answer: Could you spell your surname, please?
Could you please spell your surname?
Could you spell your surname?

grammar.instruction_tr: Kibar bir ricaya çevir ([en:Could you ask him to …] ile başla).
grammar.q: Tell him to call me back today.
answer: Could you ask him to call me back today?
Could you ask him to call me back today, please?
Could you please ask him to call me back today?
grammar.explain_tr: [en:ask somebody to] + yalın fiil: kibar bir mesaj bırakma kalıbı.

grammar.q: Kelimeleri sırala: [tr:Sizi müdüre bağlayayım.]
answer: I'll put you through to the manager.
grammar.explain_tr: [en:put somebody through to …] = telefonu birine bağlamak.

grammar.q: Kelimeleri sırala: [tr:Pardon, e-posta adresinizi tam anlayamadım.]
answer: Sorry, I didn't catch your email address.

grammar.q: Mr Şen isn't at his desk? OK, can I ___ a message for him? (bırakmak)
answer: leave

speaking.question_en: What did you do last weekend? Tell me about it.
speaking.instruction_tr: Geçen hafta sonu neler yaptığını anlat (geçmiş zaman). En az 3 cümle.

speaking.question_en: What are you working on these days, and what are your plans for next month?
speaking.instruction_tr: Bu aralar ne üzerinde çalıştığını ve gelecek ay için planlarını anlat.
speaking.focus: the present continuous and future forms

speaking.question_en: Compare your city with another city you know. Which one do you prefer and why?
speaking.instruction_tr: Yaşadığın şehri bildiğin başka bir şehirle karşılaştır; hangisini neden tercih ediyorsun?

speaking.question_en: Tell me about your first day at work. What happened, and what did you do?
speaking.instruction_tr: İşteki ilk gününü anlat: neler oldu, neler yaptın? Geçmiş zaman kullan. En az 3 cümle.
speaking.focus: the past simple (regular and irregular verbs)

speaking.question_en: Describe your office or workplace. What is there, and what isn't there?
speaking.instruction_tr: Ofisini ya da iş yerini anlat: neler var, neler yok? [en:some], [en:any], [en:a lot of], [en:much], [en:many] kullan.
speaking.focus: countable and uncountable nouns with some, any, much, many, a lot of

speaking.question_en: A customer calls your office and wants to speak to your manager, but your manager is out. What do you say on the phone?
speaking.instruction_tr: Bir müşteri arıyor ve müdürünle konuşmak istiyor ama müdürün ofiste değil. Telefonda ne söylersin? Telefon kalıplarını kullan (mesaj almak, geri arama sözü vermek).
speaking.focus: telephone phrases, polite requests and will for promises

writing.instruction_tr: Bir iş e-postası yaz: geçen hafta bir müşteriye/iş arkadaşına bir dosya göndermeyi unuttun. Özür dile, dosyayı eklediğini söyle ve gelecek hafta için bir toplantı öner. Selamlama ve kapanış kullan.
writing.prompt_en: Write a work email: you forgot to send a file last week. Apologise, say that you have attached it now, and suggest a meeting for next week. Use a greeting and a closing.
writing.focus: work email phrases, past simple, future forms

writing.instruction_tr: Bir otele e-posta yaz: gelecek ay bir iş seyahati için iki gecelik oda ayırtmak istiyorsun. Tarihleri söyle, fiyatı ve kahvaltıyı sor, kibar ricalar kullan. Selamlama ve kapanış kullan.
writing.prompt_en: Write an email to a hotel: you want to book a room for two nights for a business trip next month. Give the dates, ask about the price and breakfast, and use polite requests. Use a greeting and a closing.
writing.focus: work email phrases, polite requests, questions, future forms

writing.instruction_tr: Müdürüne kısa bir e-posta yaz: geçen hafta bir fuara ya da bir müşteri ziyaretine gittin. Ne yaptığını ve kimlerle görüştüğünü anlat, iki şeyi karşılaştır (ör. iki ürün ya da iki firma) ve bundan sonra ne yapacağını söyle. Selamlama ve kapanış kullan.
writing.prompt_en: Write a short email to your manager about a trade fair or a client visit last week. Say what you did and who you met, compare two things (for example two products or two companies), and say what you are going to do next. Use a greeting and a closing.
writing.focus: past simple, comparatives, future forms, work email phrases
